name: mame07
title: MAME 0.7 (DJGPP + Allegro, 1997)
_doc: MAME 0.7: Super Cobra, Amidar's US version, Crazy Climber's Japanese one, Pooyan, Phoenix and Pleiades join; Scramble gets its real colours; Gorf and Robby Roto boot and do not work, and Moon Quasar is there and does not either -- the release's own words. From 0.7 the source is a separate archive (mame07s.zip) whose files are all UPPER CASE, as a DOS zip stores them, while the makefile and every #include spell them in lower case.
_units: The makefile's OBJS list, in its order and in ITS spelling (lower case); the files on disk are upper case, hence caseInsensitive. obj/osdepend.o has its own rule pointing at src/msdos/msdos.c. src/sndhrdw/psg.c is not a unit: cclimber.c includes it.
_include: The makefile's -Isrc -Isrc/z80, plus src/msdos for the osdepend rule, in the makefile's own spelling.
_defines: The makefile passes -DX86_ASM -DLSB_FIRST. X86_ASM is NOT set here: it selects the x86 assembly path, the same choice as Quake's id386=0 and Heretic's #ifndef __WATCOMC__.
_caseInsensitive: A DOS archive on a DOS file system: the makefile says src/mame.c, the disk says SRC/MAME.C. Same flag as Hexen II.
